selection_protocol: Formula and constants frozen using the geometry Train split and the 3-asset texture resolution pilot only; Val, Test and Blind were not inspected.
transform: Each component is exp(-sum(weight * raw_metric / fixed_scale)); lower raw distortion and higher quality are better.
geometry_quality: minimum of geometry_fidelity, completeness and topology_health
monotonic_policy: Retain raw metrics and raw component scores. Apply cumulative burden only within observable light-medium-heavy records of the same asset and attack. An objective no-op remains quality 1 and is excluded from contradictory ranking pairs.
